sources.title: Minutes of the Canal Gardens Committee, 14 January 2026: item 3, Café lease
passages: The Committee agreed to renew the café's lease for five years at a rent of £9,500 a year.
The tenant will keep the public toilets open during the café's hours.

sources.title: Minutes of the Alder Park Committee, 12 May 2026: item 6, Opening hours
passages: The Committee agreed that the gates would open at 7am and close at dusk throughout the summer.
A proposal to leave the gates open overnight was not supported.

sources.title: Minutes of the Canal Gardens Committee, 15 July 2026: item 5, Opening hours
passages: The Committee agreed to keep the gardens open until 10pm from June to August.
The gates will be locked at 8pm for the rest of the year.
